title: THINK! Road Safety Race Day 1: Henley Beach to Gumeracha
description: Men's Stage 1 • 164.9 km. Coastal start at Henley Beach before heading through Port Adelaide and the Adelaide Hills to Gumeracha. The route includes three ascents of Checker Hill, plus sprints in Williamstown and Lobethal.
tdu_rating_reason: Long opening stage with repeated Adelaide Hills climbs and big roadside energy.

title: Race Day 2: Angaston to Angaston
description: Men's Stage 2 • 145.6 km. A Barossa loop from Angaston with sprint points in Tanunda, three passes of Menglers Hill, and a gradual uphill run to the finish.
tdu_rating_reason: Rolling Barossa circuits and repeated Menglers Hill make it a steady grinder.

title: efex Race Day 3: Lobethal to Campbelltown
description: Men's Stage 3 • 166.2 km. A decisive Adelaide Hills day with two climbs of Mount Lofty and two ascents of Corkscrew Road before the Campbelltown finish.
tdu_rating_reason: Mount Lofty and Corkscrew twice turns this into a marquee climbing day.

title: Ziptrak® Race Day 4: Glenelg to Victor Harbor
description: Men's Stage 4 • 144.7 km. The men race from Glenelg to Victor Harbor via Chandlers Hill, Coromandel Valley, Aldinga, Yankalilla, Myponga Reservoir and Nettle Hill.
tdu_rating_reason: A punchy coast-to-hills route that suits all-rounders and strong spectators.

title: Ziptrak® Race Day 4: Glenelg to Victor Harbor
description: Women's Stage 1 • 144.7 km. A history-making shared course with the men's Stage 4, from Glenelg to Victor Harbor via the Fleurieu Peninsula.
tdu_rating_reason: Historic shared-course opener with a long, hard route across the Fleurieu.

title: Race Day 5: Christies Beach to Willunga Hill
description: Men's Stage 5 • 116.4 km. Beachside start before Coxs Hill, McLaren Vale and a new approach to two ascents of Willunga Hill for the summit finish.
tdu_rating_reason: Two ascents of Willunga Hill guarantee a selective summit-finish day.

title: Race Day 5: Christies Beach to Willunga Hill
description: Women's Stage 2 • 116.4 km. The same route as the men's Stage 5, featuring Coxs Hill, McLaren Vale and two climbs of Willunga Hill.
tdu_rating_reason: Big-climb finale with a shorter package that still feels properly punchy.

title: Race Day 6: Norwood to Stirling
description: Men's Stage 6 • 136.2 km. The final stage begins in Norwood and crosses the Adelaide Hills via Norton Summit, Checker Hill, Birdwood, Lobethal, Woodside, Hahndorf and Mylor before Stirling.
tdu_rating_reason: Final-day Norwood to Stirling packs classic Adelaide Hills climbs into the showdown.

title: Race Day 6: Norwood to Stirling
description: Women's Stage 3 • 136.2 km. The women's final stage follows the Norwood-to-Stirling route across the Adelaide Hills, including Norton Summit and Checker Hill.
tdu_rating_reason: The closing Stirling stage mixes iconic climbs with strong finale atmosphere.
